thread:
amanda: Heads-up — I'm taking handoff for the night. Primary = amanda, Secondary = samir. There's a scheduled partner load test hitting /v1/generate at 02:00 UTC. I bumped the quiet-hours pager policy earlier but wanted to call out an additional temporary tweak to avoid noise during the ramp.

samir: Thanks. Do we know expected qps and error budget risk?

amanda: Partner ops said ~1200 qps at peak for ~15m, 50-75 token avg. We might see 5–8x usual tail. Error budget impact should be small but SLO alerts may fire.

lia: incident-bot just dropped a spike alert earlier — repeated 5xxs from runtime pool-3. I'm watching logs.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 5xx-rate high on service:inference-runtime (threshold breached 3m) — alert_id=IR-5XX-202904

amanda: OK — plan: suppress low-severity page for the next 30m and escalate only on P1-level signals (latency >1.5s p95 sustained or >5% 5xx across endpoints). I updated the alert policy to add a temporary suppression rule. @dena you're still listed as backup, confirm you see the suppression?

dena: saw it. I endorse the suppression for the ramp, as long as we keep tracing and a manual rollback path. I'll be on-call for escalation.

samir: can you paste the exact change? want to runbook it quickly.

amanda: pasted below — it's a small alert policy override in the console:

```
alert: inference-5xx
original_condition: rate>1% over 3m -> page
override: add "during_load_test" tag and set action -> notify-channel only (no page) for 30m
revert_after: 30m
```

amanda: Also added a note to the handoff doc and linked the runbook section 3.4 (runtime overload) — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-overload

lia: logs show retries bubbling from one worker. I'm tailing the pool and CPU looks fine. Could be transient OOM on quantized shard. If 5xx climbs to >4% we should revert suppression and start incident bridge.

product-ops: FYI — partner ops asked for the tweak, they will pause load if we ask. Keep me posted on customer impact.

amanda: good. TL;DR for next handoff: primary watches p95 and 5xx; suppression rule expires @ ${1767456789 + 1800} (30m). If p95 > 1.5s for 3m or 5xx > 4% -> remove suppression and page SRE rota. Document this in the handoff thread.

samir: noted. I'll add a quick alert play to the runbook:
- check `runtime-pool-3` pods
- tail `/var/log/inference/*.log` for "OOM" or "kv-cache miss"
- run `rl restart pool-3` if worker unresponsive (call before restart)

amanda: tagging the escalation path too: primary -> secondary (samir) -> oncall-swe -> oncall-sre -> eng-lead. Pager windows unchanged.

ops-bot: [ACTION] alert-policy override applied by amanda. PolicyID=ap-9981, expires in 30m.

lia: seeing a few more 502s but not sustained. continuing to monitor.

dena: I'll keep secondary watch until suppression expires. If partner pauses test, remove override early.

amanda: thanks all. I'll put a short handoff note in the shift doc when I step out. If anything crosses P1 escalate immediately — don't wait for suppression to expire. :thumbsup:

samir: one last thing — can we add a tiny post-change checklist so next handoff knows where the override was applied? eg include command and console path in the handoff note. I'll add that now.

amanda: perfect. Added runbook pointer and a `#hand-offs` slack tag in the thread.

incident-bot: [INFO] suppression rule ap-9981 active until 1767460389

amanda: last_message — suppression still active, no customer-facing errors reported by partner ops. handoff update saved.
